title: Company C Revenue Review
instruction: Review Company C’s revenue dashboard for Q1–Q4, select the appropriate follow-up route in the operations review form, and submit your decision.

actions.label: Send to maintain-current-plan queue
Send to decline-review queue
Send to growth-review queue

title: Store B Sales Review
instruction: Review Store B’s sales dashboard for April–June, assess April’s sales relative to the three-month average, select the appropriate April status in the monthly sales operations form, and submit the form.

actions.label: Select 'Normal monitoring' for April status
Select 'Low-sales review' for April status
Select 'High-sales review' for April status

title: Energy Portfolio Review
instruction: Review the global energy mix dashboard, identify the largest global energy consumption source category, then route that source record to priority source monitoring for this reporting cycle.
chart_reference: Use the dashboard to determine which energy source is the largest category in global energy consumption for this routing decision.

actions.label: Route Nuclear to priority source monitoring
Route Hydroelectric to priority source monitoring
Keep Fossil Fuels on routine source monitoring

title: Urban Water Supply Review
instruction: Review the urban water-supply dashboard, identify the largest urban water-supply contribution source, then route that source record to escalated contribution review.
chart_reference: Use the dashboard to determine which urban water-supply source is the largest contribution source for this routing decision.

actions.label: Route Surface water to escalated contribution review
Route Groundwater to escalated contribution review
Route Desalination to escalated contribution review

title: Monthly River Discharge Review
instruction: Review the river-discharge dashboard for the monthly monitoring cycle and assign January to the handling route that fits its discharge position relative to the monthly average level.
chart_reference: Base the routing decision on the reported monthly discharge figures shown in the dashboard when determining January's position relative to the monthly average benchmark.

context.label: Review scope
context.value: January discharge against the monthly average benchmark

actions.label: Route January to average-band discharge monitoring
Route January to elevated discharge monitoring
Route January to reduced discharge conservation review

title: Case Surveillance Review
instruction: Review the surveillance dashboard for reported case activity across the displayed reporting period and choose the appropriate follow-up action for this record.
chart_reference: Use the case-count trend shown in the dashboard to determine which follow-up pathway should receive this record for next-step public health handling.

actions.label: Route the surveillance record to declining-case stabilization review
Route the surveillance record to background monitoring intake
Route the surveillance record to rising-case escalation follow-up

title: Respiratory Infection Review
instruction: Review the respiratory infection surveillance dashboard and select the operational route that best fits the overall case pattern for this record.
chart_reference: Use the dashboard as the evidence source for selecting the appropriate respiratory infection surveillance follow-up route.

actions.label: Route the record to easing-activity follow-up
Route the record to increasing-activity follow-up
Route the record to standard surveillance monitoring

title: Museum C Visitor Review
instruction: Review Museum C’s visitor dashboard for July–September, assess July’s visitor count relative to the three-month average, select the appropriate July status in the monthly tourism operations form, and submit the form.

actions.label: Select 'High-visitor review' for July
Select 'Normal monitoring' for July
Select 'Low-visitor review' for July

title: Town Z Tourism Review
instruction: Review the Town Z new-tourist trend dashboard for 1880-1891, then choose the follow-up route for the tourism operations trend.
chart_reference: Use the Town Z new-tourist dashboard as the evidence source for the tourism trend routing decision.

actions.label: Route to tourism decline response
Keep on routine tourism monitoring
Route to tourism growth planning

title: City A Population Review
instruction: Review the City A population dashboard for 2010-2015, then choose the follow-up route for the population planning workflow.
chart_reference: Use the City A population dashboard as the evidence source for the population trend routing decision.

actions.label: Route to population growth planning
Route to population decline response
Keep on routine population monitoring
